discrepancies.issue: GBA 11,280 SF (cost seg, site visit) vs 10,950 SF (AEI PCA / Capstan proposal footprint). PCA $/SF/yr recomputes 0.80 -> 0.78 on 11,280 SF.
discrepancies.action: Confirm survey SF; update PCA register SF

discrepancies.issue: Roof is three surfaces: 3883 aluminum panel 6,078 SF + asphalt shingle 2,962 SF; 3875 EPDM 2,240 SF. PCA $28,800 and Able signed $29,313 have no stated scope/qty.
discrepancies.action: Get Able scope by roof section; only then create a calibration row

discrepancies.issue: Cost seg models three identical 18,000 SF buildings (54,000 SF) vs GBA 53,700 vs King/Pegnato roof area 52,233 SF; roof modeled EPDM adhered. Roof condition not assessed by a cost seg.
discrepancies.action: Use for quantity cross-check only; roof condition stays PCI/King-Pegnato conflict

discrepancies.issue: Unsprinklered-looking (alarm only), church tenant, auto-service suites with compressed air [SPECULATIVE use-group/insurer exposure, same pattern as 29000 Info Ln].
discrepancies.action: Confirm sprinkler status and use groups

discrepancies.issue: Report text says "municipal septic system" and a "120 Volt feed rated at 400 Amps"; both look like errors.
discrepancies.action: Verify sewer vs septic and electrical service

discrepancies.issue: Study owner is Muirkirk Properties, LLC (also files 1900 N Broadway on its 8825). PCA register lists "Muirkirk EMG 2014" and "Muirkirk 12201-12225 roof ~2008, warranty to 2028". Cost seg shows 90,000 SF EPDM roof with no install year.
discrepancies.action: Confirm whether the 2014 EMG and the 2008 roof belong to 9050 Red Branch

discrepancies.issue: PIS 09/01/2015 is the acquisition date; both studies were run in 2024 (retroactive). Quantities are 2024 takeoffs of 2015-acquired buildings.
discrepancies.action: Tag as acquisition-date facts; do not read PIS as build year

discrepancies.issue: Tax register Sch. L depreciable assets $1,803,121-$1,803,122 equals the full settlement total, while the study depreciable allocation is $1,537,638 (pre-study estimate had $360,000 land). Land split in the books needs checking.
discrepancies.action: Tax/basis item for Controller/CPA; no change to PCA data

discrepancies.issue: PIS 01/01/2026 (CSSI) vs ~01/29/2026 (tax register). Lease ran to 09/30/2026 (renewal status unknown). CSSI allocates $22.7K to an emergency generator and $21.4K to dock equipment, and $23.3K to HVAC; building notes mention no generator and only two unit heaters.
discrepancies.action: Confirm PIS date, lease status, and whether a generator exists

discrepancies.issue: Only source for a hydraulic 2-stop elevator (modeled basis $52,562), full basement, and wet-pipe sprinklers (55,342 SF). PES PCA body is missing.
discrepancies.action: Add elevator to asset register; get inspection certificate and maintenance contract

discrepancies.issue: Electrical paragraph is word-for-word identical in both studies (120/208V 200-400A; anchor tenants 480/277V 800-2,000A). Template language.
discrepancies.action: Mark electrical service UNVERIFIED; verify from panel schedules

discrepancies.issue: Quantities and unit costs come from engineering takeoffs and RSMeans/Marshall & Swift pricing, not contractor bids. Component condition and remaining life are not assessed.
discrepancies.action: Price Basis = COST_SEG_MODELED; never blend with PCA or contractor prices

discrepancies.issue: Capstan proposal calls for a "virtual site visit"; the report names Ziv Carmel as conducting a site visit on 7/8/2025.
discrepancies.action: Treat quantities as modeled; physical verification unknown
